caption: The drawing depicts the head of a stag with large antlers rendered in a style mimicking cross-stitch embroidery. The stag's head is oriented to the left, showing one visible eye and the full length of its snout. The head and neck are composed of a range of reddish-brown and beige colors, with areas of light tan and cream used for lighter patches around the eye, muzzle, and throat. The antlers are large and extend upward and outward from the head, rendered in shades of light beige and pale gray. The background consists of a grid pattern in very light gray or pale blue. The lines forming the grid add to the cross-stitched effect. The artist's signature and the date appear in red script at the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Afghan (Detail)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
